name: PageFormat
doc: A page size in points (1/72").

methods.name: custom
methods.doc: A custom page size; both dimensions must be positive and finite.

methods.name: landscape
methods.doc: This format oriented so width >= height (returns `this` if already so).

methods.name: portrait
methods.doc: This format oriented so height >= width (returns `this` if already so).

methods.name: mediaBox
methods.doc: The `/MediaBox` rectangle `[0, 0, width, height]` for this format.

name: expandTabs
doc: Expand `line`'s tabs to `tabWidth` columns.

name: preformat
doc: Turn source text into text the wrapping engine will not destroy: expand tabs,  then substitute U+00A0 for the spaces — and ONLY the spaces — it would  otherwise eat.

name: NBSP
doc: The no-break space the substitution below uses.

name: GoToAction
doc: A GoTo action: jump to a page in this document.

name: UriAction
doc: A URI action: open an external URL.

name: SubmitAction
doc: A SubmitForm action: send the form's field values to `url`.

properties.name: fields
properties.doc: Fully-qualified field names.

properties.name: exclude
properties.doc: Treat `fields` as an exclusion list (/Flags IncludeExclude).

properties.name: format
properties.doc: Wire format.

name: ResetAction
doc: A ResetForm action: clear the named fields, or every field.

name: JavaScriptAction
doc: A JavaScript action.

name: PdfAction
doc: Any action this library models, for an annotation's /A.

name: FieldActions
doc: A field's additional-actions (/AA), PDF 32000-1 table 197.

properties.name: keystroke
properties.doc: /K — fires on each keystroke while the value is being edited.

properties.name: format
properties.doc: /F — formats the value for display.

properties.name: validate
properties.doc: /V — validates the value when it changes.

properties.name: calculate
properties.doc: /C — recalculates the value when another field changes.

name: FieldActionsUpdate
doc: A field-actions update: an action to set, `null` to remove that trigger, and  an absent key to leave it as it is — the same shape `SetStyle` takes.

name: pdfText
doc: A PdfString tagged object carrying a PDF text string.

name: firstElementOnPage
doc: The first structure element, in TREE ORDER, whose content lies on `page`  (1-based, as `doc.pageRef` and `Page.Number` are).

name: encodeAction
doc: Build the /A dict for `a`.

name: urlOf
doc: The URL from a SubmitForm /F: a /FS /URL filespec, or a bare string, which  some producers write.

name: parseAction
doc: Parse `annot`'s /A action, or undefined when absent or unmodelled.

name: parseStandaloneAction
doc: Parse an action dict that is not an annotation's /A — a field's /AA /F, say.

name: parseActionDict
doc: The body shared by both: `host` is where a GoTo destination may live besides  the action's own /D.

name: parseFieldActions
doc: Read a field's /AA into the typed view.

name: encodeFieldActions
doc: Build the /AA dict for a plain set of triggers, or undefined when none were  given.

name: applyFieldActions
doc: Apply an update to a field's /AA.

properties.name: entry
properties.doc: The raw /N (or /AS-selected) entry, un-promoted: a ref, or an inline stream.

properties.name: stream
properties.doc: The resolved appearance stream.

properties.name: place
properties.doc: Maps the /Matrix-transformed /BBox onto /Rect (PDF 32000-1 §12.5.5).

name: numArray
doc: Resolve `o` to a fixed-length array of finite numbers, or undefined.

name: annotFlags
doc: The annotation's /F flag bitfield (0 when absent).

name: isAnnotVisible
doc: True when a static page render should draw this annotation: not Hidden, not NoView, and not a /Popup — a popup is the note window belonging to a parent markup annotation, which viewers draw only while the note is open.

name: normalEntry
doc: The raw /AP /N entry to draw.

name: resolveAppearance
doc: The appearance to draw for `annot` and where to place it, or undefined when there is none usable: no /AP, an /N state subdict with no matching /AS, a missing /Rect or /BBox, or a degenerate placement.

name: iconAppearance
doc: The icon a viewer draws for a /Text or /FileAttachment annotation that has  NO /AP key at all (`v0tz.1`), built on the fly and never written into the  document — rendering must not mutate, and a viewer that does draw its own  icons should go on doing so for the notes we create.

name: fillOf
doc: /C as the icon's fill: an empty array is a stated TRANSPARENT (12.5.2), so  `null`; anything unusable is `undefined` and takes the default.

name: viewerAppearance
doc: What a viewer draws for an annotation with NO /AP key: the icon for a /Text  or /FileAttachment (`v0tz.1`), the caption box for a /Stamp (`v0tz.2`),  and nothing for anything else.

name: shapeAppearance
doc: A shape or text-markup annotation with no /AP, drawn on the fly (`kapw`).

name: stampAppearance
doc: A /Stamp with no /AP, drawn as the caption box `Page.AddStamp` writes  (`v0tz.2`) — built on the fly and never written, like the icons.

name: stampLabel
doc: /Name's caption, else /Contents' first non-empty line, else DRAFT.

name: stampColor
doc: /C with 1, 3 or 4 components; red otherwise — an EMPTY /C would be a  transparent stamp, which is an invisible one.

name: freeTextAppearance
doc: A /FreeText with no /AP, drawn from /RC (else /Contents) exactly as  `regenerateAppearance` would draw it — one builder, `freeTextParts` — but  wrapped INLINE: its fonts and any /GS0 live in the stream's own  /Resources, so rendering allocates nothing (`v0tz.3`).

name: Annotation
doc: A live, mutable handle over an annotation dictionary.

name: MarkupType

name: ShapeType

name: SquareCircleAnnotation

name: LineEnding

name: LineAnnotation

name: PolyType

name: PolyAnnotation

name: CaretAnnotation

methods.name: Flatten
methods.doc: Bake just this annotation into static page content: draw its /AP /N  appearance into the page's /Contents at its /Rect and drop it from  /Annots.

name: RedactAnnotation
doc: A /Redact annotation (PDF 32000-1 §12.5.6.23): a *mark* over a region, plus  the overlay to paint when it is applied.

methods.name: Flatten

name: PopupAnnotation
doc: A /Popup annotation: a companion window bound to a parent markup via /Parent  (the parent carries /Popup back).

properties.name: page
properties.doc: 0-based page index — XFDF's own convention for the page attribute.

properties.name: dict
properties.doc: Self-contained annotation dict: refs inlined, STRIPPED keys removed.

properties.name: popupName
properties.doc: /NM of this annotation's popup, when it has one.

properties.name: inReplyTo
properties.doc: /NM of the annotation this one replies to, when it is a reply.

name: inlineRefs
doc: Deep-copy `o`, resolving every reference to the object it points at, so the  result stands alone with no dependency on the document's object map.

name: allocStreams
doc: Deep-copy `o`, replacing every inline stream with a reference to a freshly  allocated object.

name: nameOf
doc: An annotation's /NM as a string; undefined when absent.

name: linkedName
doc: The /NM of the annotation `key` points at, minting one if it has none.

name: collectAnnots
doc: Read every non-widget annotation into the format-neutral model.

name: namedOnPage
doc: Index a page's existing annotations by /NM, for replace-on-import.

name: annotsArray
doc: The page's /Annots array, created and attached when absent.

name: applyAnnots
doc: Graft annotations into the document, reporting what landed and what did not.

name: XFDF_SUBTYPES
doc: The 18 annotation types the XFDF vocabulary covers, as PDF /Subtype names.

name: QuadCorners
doc: A quad's four corners (PDF QuadPoints order: 1=TL, 2=TR, 3=BL, 4=BR).

name: FreeTextParts
doc: A FreeText's appearance, ready to wrap: its geometry, content body, the  faces the body's `Tf` operators name (key → Standard-14 face) and its  constant opacity (`v0tz.3`).

name: quadsBBox
doc: Axis-aligned bounding box over all corner points of `quads`.
return_type: { minX: number; minY: number; maxX: number; maxY: number }

name: offsetQuads
doc: Split `quads` into per-quad corners, translated into form space (origin at  the quad bbox lower-left, so the form /BBox [0 0 w h] maps onto /Rect).

name: drawHighlight
doc: Fill each quad with the markup color (TL→TR→BR→BL polygon).

name: redactMarkBody
doc: Pending redaction mark: stroke each quad's outline in the mark colour and  fill nothing, so the content underneath stays readable.

name: quadSpan
doc: Per-quad geometry: left/right x span, bottom y, and quad height.
return_type: { xl: number; xr: number; yb: number; h: number }

name: strokeLines
doc: Stroke a horizontal line across each quad at fractional height `frac`  (0 = bottom, 0.5 = middle), with width proportional to quad height.

name: drawUnderline
doc: Underline: a stroke along the bottom edge of each quad.

name: drawStrikeOut
doc: Strike-out: a stroke through the middle of each quad.

name: drawSquiggly
doc: Stroke a zig-zag along the bottom of each quad.

name: freeTextBoxBody
doc: Body for a text box of size w×h at the origin: optional fill, optional inset  border stroke, then wrapped/aligned text (text inset by the border width).

name: freeTextFrame
doc: Fill and inset border of a text box of size w×h at the origin — the part of  a FreeText appearance that does not depend on its text, shared by the plain  and the rich (`v0tz.3`) text paths.

name: installShapeAP
doc: Install `body` as the annotation's /AP /N, wrapping in a /GS0 ExtGState when  opacity < 1 (matching the markup opacity path).

name: paintOp
doc: Painting op for the fill/stroke selection: B = both, S = stroke, f = fill.

name: drawRect
doc: Rectangle inset by half the border so the stroke stays inside the box.

name: cloudBulge
doc: The scallop bulge height a /BE asks for, or undefined for a straight border.

name: cloudBodyFrom

doc: The /Matrix that turns the layout box onto the widget rect.

doc: Body ops for wrapped, aligned text in a box, top-anchored.

doc: Generate and install appearance stream(s) for one terminal field across all  its widgets.

name: PAD

properties.name: attached
properties.doc: /Attached edges, pagination artifacts only.

properties.name: bbox
properties.doc: The artifact's extent, in the page's default user space.

doc: RunLengthDecode (PackBits): length 0..127 => copy len+1 literals;  129..255 => repeat next byte 257-len times; 128 => EOD.

doc: ASCII85Encode: 4 bytes -> 5 base-85 chars in 0x21..0x75; an all-zero 4-byte  group emits 'z'; a partial final group of k bytes (1..3) emits k+1 chars  (pad the group with zero bytes, drop the trailing chars).

doc: ASCIIHexEncode: each byte -> two uppercase hex digits, terminated by '>'.

name: runLengthEncode
doc: RunLengthEncode (PackBits): the inverse of runLengthDecode.

doc: EAN/UPC check digit for `digits` (weights 3,1,3,1,...

methods.doc: The logical page-label ranges from /Root /PageLabels, ascending; [] when  there is no /PageLabels.

methods.name: SetPageLabels
methods.doc: Replace /Root /PageLabels with `labels`; an empty array removes it.

methods.name: PageLabelFor
methods.doc: Resolve a 0-based page index to its rendered label (prefix + numeral).

methods.name: GetNamedDestinations
methods.doc: All named destinations, merging the /Names /Dests name tree and the legacy  /Dests dict (legacy wins on a clash), sorted by name.

methods.name: SetNamedDestination
methods.doc: Upsert `name` → `dest` into the /Names /Dests name tree (creating the  containers as needed), writing a single flat node — no balanced-tree  rebalancing.

methods.name: RemoveNamedDestination
methods.doc: Remove `name` from both the name tree and the legacy /Dests dict, pruning  the now-empty containers.

methods.name: GetOpenAction
methods.doc: What this document does when it is opened: go to a view (`kind: 'dest'`)  or run an action (`kind: 'action'`).

methods.name: SetOpenDestination
methods.doc: Open the document at `dest`, written as a destination.

methods.name: SetOpenAction
methods.doc: Run `action` when the document is opened, written as an action dict.

methods.name: RemoveOpenAction
methods.doc: Remove the catalog /OpenAction.

methods.name: GetJavaScripts
methods.doc: Document-level JavaScript: every entry of the /Names /JavaScript tree,  sorted by name.

methods.name: SetJavaScript
methods.doc: Upsert a document-level script, run by the viewer when the document opens.

methods.name: RemoveJavaScript
methods.doc: Remove a document-level script.

methods.name: GetAttachments
methods.doc: All document-level embedded files (the /Names /EmbeddedFiles tree), sorted  by name.

methods.name: AddAttachment
methods.doc: Embed `bytes` as an attachment named `name`, upserting it into the  /Names /EmbeddedFiles name tree (overwriting a same-named entry).

methods.name: RemoveAttachment
methods.doc: Remove the named attachment from the name tree (and /AF).

methods.name: GetCollection
methods.doc: The /Root /Collection portfolio presentation settings, or undefined.

methods.name: SetCollection
methods.doc: Write (or replace) the /Root /Collection portfolio settings.

methods.name: RemoveCollection
methods.doc: Remove /Root /Collection.

methods.name: ensureInfo
methods.doc: @internal The /Info dictionary, created and linked from the trailer when  absent.

methods.name: SetXmp
methods.doc: Set/replace the document XMP packet from `update` (merged over the current  packet; `null` deletes a field), mirroring shared fields back into /Info.

methods.name: ClearMetadata
methods.doc: Remove all document metadata: drop the /Info dictionary and the catalog's  /Root /Metadata XMP packet, so /Info and XMP stay consistent (the mirror  counterpart of SetMetadata <-> SetXmp).

methods.name: Optimize
methods.doc: Losslessly shrink the document in place: subset already-embedded fonts to  the glyphs actually shown, merge byte-identical streams, and recompress  stream payloads.

methods.name: ConvertColors
methods.doc: Convert the document's colour to `opts.to` in place — `'gray'`, `'rgb'`  or `'cmyk'` — across page content, form XObjects, tiling patterns, Type 3  glyph procedures, image XObjects, inline images, shadings and  annotations.

methods.name: ConvertToGrayscale
methods.doc: Convert the document's colour to DeviceGray in place: page content, form  XObjects, tiling patterns, Type 3 glyph procedures, image XObjects,  shadings and annotations.

methods.name: FlattenLayers
methods.doc: Flatten optional content in place: keep only what the default  configuration SHOWS, then take the vocabulary away.

methods.name: ConvertXfaToAcroForm
methods.doc: Convert this document's XFA form to a real `/AcroForm` field tree.

methods.name: Save
methods.doc: Serialize the live document to PDF bytes (mark-sweep from /Root, renumbered).

methods.name: AddFont
methods.doc: Parse and register a font program (TrueType/OpenType sfnt bytes), returning  a handle to pass as the `font` option to {@link Page.AddText} /  {@link Page.AddTextBlock}.

methods.name: AddFontFile
methods.doc: Read a font program from disk (synchronous) and register it; the file path  counterpart of {@link AddFont}, mirroring {@link WriteTo}.

methods.name: RegisterFontFolder
methods.doc: Search `dir`, recursively, when resolving a font by name.

methods.name: RegisterSystemFonts
methods.doc: Also search the platform's own font directories.

methods.name: RegisterRenderFontFolder
methods.doc: Search `dir`, recursively, when RENDERING a font the document did not embed.

methods.name: RegisterRenderSystemFonts
methods.doc: Also search the platform's own font directories when rendering.

methods.name: renderFontFaces
methods.doc: Every face the registered render folders hold.

methods.name: AddRenderFont
methods.doc: Supply one font program as BYTES for use when RENDERING a font the document did not embed — for a face that ships as a bundled asset, or comes out of an archive, with no path to point {@link RegisterRenderFontFolder} at.

methods.name: loadRenderFace
methods.doc: One render substitute face, parsed and memoized.

methods.name: renderFaceCoverage
methods.doc: The code points one render face covers, for `fontsubst.ts`'s coverage rung.

methods.name: ResolveFontByName
methods.doc: What `family` resolves to, without loading or embedding anything.

methods.name: LoadFontByName
methods.doc: The face matching `family`, registered and ready to draw with.

methods.name: LoadFontFamily
methods.doc: The four faces of `family`, ready to hand to `AddMarkdown({ style: { font } })`.

methods.name: Sign
methods.doc: Add an (invisible) digital signature.

methods.name: Certify
methods.doc: Add a *certification* (author) signature with a DocMDP transform: the  signature carries a `/Reference` DocMDP entry and the catalog gains  `/Perms /DocMDP` pointing at it, declaring which later changes are  permitted (`opts.permissions`, default `no-changes`).

methods.name: AddValidationData
methods.doc: Embed long-term-validation (LTV) data in a `/DSS` (PAdES-B-LT): for each  existing signature, store its certificate chain plus the OCSP/CRL bytes  returned by the `opts.getOCSP`/`opts.getCRL` callbacks, indexed by a `/VRI`  entry, and append the store as an incremental update (existing signatures  preserved verbatim).

methods.name: AddDocumentTimestamp
methods.doc: Append a document timestamp (`/DocTimeStamp`, ETSI.RFC3161) as an  incremental update, enabling PAdES-B-LTA archival on top of B-LT.

methods.name: VerifySignatures
methods.doc: Verify every signature in the document: recompute each `/ByteRange` digest,  verify the detached CMS, and diff what changed after each signature.

methods.name: VerifyDocumentTimestamps
methods.doc: Verify every document timestamp (`/DocTimeStamp`) in the document: check  each token's message-imprint binding to the `/ByteRange` and the TSA's CMS  signature, returning one {@link DocumentTimestampReport} per field.

methods.name: WriteTo
methods.doc: Serialize and write to a file path (synchronous), mirroring OpenFile.

methods.name: InsertPage
methods.doc: Insert a page so it becomes 1-based page `at` (1..Pages.length+1): a blank  page (of `source` when it is a {@link PageFormat}, else {@link PageFormat.A4}),  or a deep copy of `source` when it is a {@link Page} (from this or another  Document, keeping that page's own size).

methods.name: AddPage
methods.doc: Append a page: a blank page (of `source` when it is a {@link PageFormat},  else {@link PageFormat.A4}), or a deep copy of `source` when it is a  {@link Page}.

methods.name: NewFlow
methods.doc: Create a {@link Flow} layout container bound to this document.

methods.name: AddMarkdown

params.name: options

methods.doc: Render a whole Markdown document, appending freshly sized pages to the end  of this document.

methods.name: AddHtml

params.name: options

methods.return_type: { pages: Page[]; skipped: NotRendered[]; unsupported: UnsupportedDeclaration[] }
methods.doc: Render a whole HTML document, appending freshly sized pages to the end of  this document.

methods.name: NewFloatingBox
methods.doc: Create a {@link FloatingBox} bound to this document.

methods.name: NewTilingPattern
methods.doc: Create a reusable tiling pattern (PDF PatternType 1): `draw` paints one  tile into a builder scoped to tile space, and the pattern repeats on an  `xStep` x `yStep` lattice wherever it is used.

methods.name: NewTemplate
methods.doc: Create a reusable template: a Form XObject you draw once and place on any  number of pages, allocated as a single object however often it is used.

methods.name: InsertPages
methods.doc: Insert every page of `other` so the first becomes 1-based page `at`  (1..Pages.length+1), shifting existing pages down.

methods.name: Append
methods.doc: Append every page of `other` to the end of this document.

methods.name: Merge
methods.doc: Build a new document from copies of all `docs`, in order.

methods.name: Redact
methods.doc: Redact regions on a single page (1-based `page` number); see `Page.Redact`.

methods.name: RedactText
methods.doc: Redact every occurrence of `find` across all pages; see `Page.RedactText`.

methods.name: MarkRedactText
methods.doc: Mark every occurrence of `find` across all pages; see `Page.MarkRedactText`.

methods.name: ApplyRedactions
methods.doc: Apply every /Redact mark across all pages; see `Page.ApplyRedactions`.

methods.name: ReplaceText
methods.doc: Replace every occurrence of `find` with `replacement` across all pages; see  `Page.ReplaceText`.

methods.name: Overlay
methods.doc: Stamp a single source page onto many pages of this document as one shared  Form XObject — letterheads, watermarks, backgrounds.

methods.name: AddWatermark
methods.doc: Stamp a repeating text or image watermark across a page range.

methods.name: AddHeaderFooter
methods.doc: Stamp header and/or footer text across a page range.

methods.name: AddBatesNumbering
methods.doc: Stamp a Bates sequence across a page range (bottom-right, `{bates}`, 10pt  by default).

methods.name: NUp
methods.doc: Impose this document's pages `cols`×`rows` per sheet into a **new**  Document (this one is unmodified, like Split/ExtractPages).

methods.name: Booklet
methods.doc: Impose this document's pages as a saddle-stitch booklet into a **new**  Document (this one is unmodified, like NUp/Split/ExtractPages).

methods.name: FlattenAnnotations
methods.doc: Flatten annotations on every page into static page content; see  `Page.FlattenAnnotations`.

methods.name: FlattenForm
methods.doc: Flatten the interactive form into static page content: generate every  field's appearance, bake each widget into its page at its /Rect, then drop  the document /AcroForm.

name: flattenForm
doc: Flatten the interactive form: generate every field's appearance, bake each widget annotation into its page's content via the L1 mechanism, then drop the widget annotations and the document /AcroForm.

name: Glyph
doc: One decoded character code: its text, em-width, byte span, and word-space flag.

properties.name: code
properties.doc: The character code itself, as the show string spelled it.

properties.name: cid
properties.doc: The CID this code selects, for a composite font; 0 for a simple font.

properties.name: vertical
properties.doc: Vertical-writing metrics, present only under `/WMode 1`.

name: VerticalMetrics
doc: A glyph's vertical-writing metrics, in em units (glyph space / 1000).

properties.name: w1
properties.doc: `w1`: displacement along the writing direction.

properties.name: vx
properties.doc: Position vector X: horizontal origin -> vertical origin.

properties.name: vy
properties.doc: Position vector Y.

name: RunMetrics
doc: A decoded run's text and the metrics needed to advance past it.

properties.name: width
properties.doc: Sum of horizontal displacements, em units.

properties.name: vwidth
properties.doc: Sum of vertical displacements, em units; 0 for a horizontal font.

name: Type3Data
doc: What a renderer needs to draw a Type 3 font: its glyphs are content streams, not outlines, and they are described in a glyph space the font itself defines.

properties.name: fontMatrix
properties.doc: Glyph space -> text space.

properties.name: resources
properties.doc: The font's own `/Resources`; undefined means "inherit the showing stream's".

properties.name: procs
properties.doc: Character code -> its glyph procedure, resolved through `/Encoding  /Differences` and `/CharProcs`.

name: FontStyle
doc: A font's weight and slant, as the document declares them.

methods.name: dictWidth
methods.doc: The width the font DICTIONARY states for `key`, or `undefined` when it states none.

methods.name: decodeRun
methods.doc: Decode bytes into text plus the run's advance metrics.

methods.name: decode
methods.doc: Decode a show-string's bytes into Unicode text.

methods.name: encodeChar
methods.doc: Map one Unicode character to its 1-byte code in this font's encoding, or  `undefined` if the font cannot represent it.

methods.name: encode
methods.doc: Encode `text` to show-string bytes in this font's encoding.

methods.name: decodeGlyphs
methods.doc: Decode bytes into one record per character code (positions, em-widths).

properties.name: codeWidth
properties.doc: The narrowest character code this font admits, in bytes: 1 for a simple font, 2 for Identity-H and most composite fonts.

properties.name: wmode
properties.doc: Writing mode from the `/Encoding` CMap: 0 horizontal, 1 vertical.

properties.name: name
properties.doc: The font's /BaseFont name (subset prefix preserved), or undefined if absent.

properties.name: bold
properties.doc: True when the document declares this font bold / italic.

properties.name: type3
properties.doc: Set for a Type 3 font: its glyph procedures and the space they draw in.

properties.name: dict
properties.doc: The font dictionary this is a view over.

name: VerticalWidths
doc: `/W2` and `/DW2`, in glyph space.

properties.name: w1
properties.doc: CID -> w1y.

properties.name: v
properties.doc: CID -> [vx, vy].

properties.name: dw2

name: SimpleEncoding
doc: A simple font's `/Encoding`, taken apart so callers can choose how much to  guess.

properties.name: base
properties.doc: code -> Unicode from the base encoding alone, before `/Differences`.

properties.name: unicode
properties.doc: code -> Unicode after `/Differences`.

properties.name: names
properties.doc: code -> the glyph name `/Differences` assigns, for those codes only.

properties.name: baseNames
properties.doc: code -> glyph name from the base encoding the font *named*, when we have a  table for it.

properties.name: implicit
properties.doc: True when the font dict carries no `/Encoding`: the font program's built-in  encoding governs, and {@link base} is only this parser's default guess.

name: glyphDisplacement
doc: The text-space displacement one glyph contributes (32000-1 9.4.4).

name: tjShift
doc: The text-space shift a `TJ` number contributes.

name: glyphOrigin
doc: Where a glyph is *drawn*, given the pen position it advances from.

name: descriptorOf

name: fontStyleOf

name: parseType3

name: cidSystemOrdering
doc: The `/CIDSystemInfo /Ordering` of a composite font's DESCENDANT, or undefined when it states none or names a registry other than Adobe.

name: decodeLatin1
doc: A destination NAME is a byte string compared literally, never decoded as  document text — `collectNameTree` keys are latin1 of the raw bytes.

name: parseType0VerticalWidths
doc: Parse the descendant CIDFont's `/W2` (+ `/DW2`) for a vertical composite font.

name: resolveEncodingCMap
doc: The `/Encoding` of a composite font, as a code -> CID CMap.

name: resolveSimpleEncoding
doc: Resolve a simple font's `/Encoding` without collapsing the unknowns.

name: std14Widths

return_type: { widths: Map<number, number>; missing: number; hasMissing: boolean } | undefined

doc: Per-code advances from the embedded font program, in glyph space, or `undefined` when the descriptor embeds none we can read.

return_type: { widths: Map<number, number>; dw: number; hasDw: boolean }

name: buildCidProgramWidths
doc: A composite font's advance lookup over its embedded program, keyed by CID.

name: Alloc

name: subsetTag

name: sanitizeName
doc: Strip characters PostScript names disallow; fall back to a generic name.

name: buildW
doc: Group a sorted CID list into the array form of /W: `cid [w w …]` per run of  consecutive CIDs.

name: utf16beHex
doc: UTF-16BE hex of a destination string (each code unit -> 4 hex digits).

name: buildToUnicode
doc: Build a /ToUnicode CMap mapping each CID (2-byte) to its Unicode text.

name: buildEmbeddedFont
doc: Build the PDF font object graph for one embedded font and return the Type0 font dict (descendant CIDFont, FontDescriptor, FontFile, /CIDToGIDMap, and /ToUnicode streams are allocated via `alloc`).

name: FaceStyle

properties.name: weight
properties.doc: CSS weight, 1..1000.

properties.name: italic

name: StyleRequest
doc: What a caller asked for, normalised.

name: LoadFontOptions
doc: A style request alongside the ordinary font options.

properties.name: weight
properties.doc: CSS weight, 1..1000.

properties.name: italic
properties.doc: Prefer an italic or oblique face.

name: FontMatch
doc: What a name resolves to -- reported without loading or embedding anything.

properties.name: family
properties.doc: The family as the FONT states it (ID 16 where present), not as asked for.

properties.name: subfamily
properties.doc: The subfamily as the font states it (ID 17 where present).

properties.name: weight
properties.doc: DERIVED weight and slant, not the raw usWeightClass or macStyle bits.

properties.name: exact

name: FontFamily
doc: The four faces emphasis selects between, loaded from disk.

name: weightFromSubfamily

name: deriveStyle
doc: A face's derived weight and slant.

name: clampWeight
doc: A requested weight, defaulted and clamped.

name: familyMatches
doc: Whether `names` belongs to the family `want`, which must ALREADY be trimmed  and lower-cased.

name: weightKey
doc: A lexicographic sort key for `have` against the desired weight `want`, under CSS Fonts 4 5.2's weight walk.

name: matchFace
doc: The face of family `want` that best answers `req`, or undefined when no face belongs to that family at all.

name: matchChain

properties.name: family
properties.doc: Name ID 1, or '' when the font states none -- see `namesFromTables`.

properties.name: subfamily
properties.doc: Name ID 2 -- 'Regular', 'Bold Italic', ...

properties.doc: Name ID 17, where the font states one.

doc: Read the naming and style fields from a whole sfnt buffer.

properties.doc: Rewrite a `post` v2.0 table to v3.0, discarding its glyph names.

doc: Rewrite a `post` v2.0 table as v3.0: the same 32-byte header, without the  glyph-name index and string pool that follow it.

name: shrinkGlyf
doc: Sparse-shrink a glyf font: keep `numGlyphs` and GID numbering, blank the outlines of glyphs outside `keep` (closed over composite components), and drop DROP_TABLES.

name: emitSpan
doc: Re-emit one DICT span: its operands, then its operator.

name: charsetLength
doc: Byte length of a charset at `off`.

name: encodingLength
doc: Byte length of an Encoding at `off`.

name: shrinkNameKeyedCff
doc: Sparse-shrink a **name-keyed** CFF (`FontFile3` `/Subtype /Type1C`): keep `numGlyphs` and GID numbering, replace the charstrings of glyphs outside `keep` with a bare `endchar`, and re-assemble preserving every structure a simple font dict's code -> name -> GID chain runs through.

doc: Sparse-shrink a CFF program: keep `numGlyphs` and GID numbering, replace the charstrings of glyphs outside `keep` with a bare `endchar`, and re-emit the original charset so CID->GID resolution is unchanged.

name: DROP_TABLES
doc: Tables carrying no information needed to render already-positioned text:  layout (GSUB/GPOS/GDEF/BASE/JSTF/kern), hinting/device metrics  (hdmx/VDMX/LTSH/gasp/PCLT), embedded bitmaps (EBDT/EBLC/CBDT/CBLC/sbix),  colour/vector extras (SVG /MATH), and the signature (DSIG).

name: systemFontFolders
doc: The platform's font directories, in search order.

name: readAt
doc: Read exactly `length` bytes at `offset`, or as many as the file holds.

name: peekNames
doc: The naming fields of every face in the file at `path`, read through PARTIAL file reads.

properties.name: serif

name: SubstMatch

name: wantedCodepoints
doc: The code points this font dict can emit, bounded to {@link WANTED_CAP}.

name: rangeAdmits
doc: Whether a face's stated ranges could hold any of `wanted`.

name: resolveSubstitute
doc: The installed face that substitutes for a non-embedded font, or `undefined` when none should -- an ordinary outcome, where the caller falls back to the bundled Standard-14 face exactly as it did before this existed.

name: WANTED_CAP
doc: How many code points a coverage score is taken over.

name: CID_PROBE_LIMIT
doc: How far into a collection the CID probe walks.

name: CID_PROBE_STEP
doc: PRIME, and that is the whole point: a collection's CIDs are grouped by kind  -- Adobe-Japan1's 1..230 are proportional Latin -- so a step sharing a  factor with that structure samples one region and reports that a Latin-only  face covers a Japanese font.

name: CONFIRM_CAP
doc: How many admitted faces are confirmed against their real `cmap`.

name: MIN_COVERAGE
doc: Below this fraction of `wanted`, a face is not a substitute for this font --  drawing a tenth of a page's characters is worse than boxes throughout,  because it looks like a font that works.

doc: One step of the path from /AcroForm /Fields down to a field: the live array  the node sits in, and where in it.

doc: The chain of steps from `container` down to `target`, or undefined when the  field is not in this tree.

name: detachWidgets
doc: Drop every dict in `dead` from every page's /Annots.

doc: Drop refs to any removed node from /AcroForm /CO, the calculation order.

doc: Remove a terminal field: unwire it from the field tree, drop its widgets from  every page, and prune the intermediate nodes it leaves empty.

doc: LSB-first bit packer that emits GIF's length-prefixed sub-blocks.

methods.doc: Flush the partial byte, the partial block, and the terminator.

name: tableBits
doc: Bits per palette index: the smallest size holding `n` entries, min 2 —  GIF's smallest legal global colour table is 4 entries.

name: lzwCompress
doc: Compress palette indices with GIF's LZW.

name: encodeGif
doc: Encode interleaved top-down 8-bit RGB as a GIF89a.

name: CharstringProgram
doc: What {@link glyphPolys} needs from a charstring-based font program.

name: OutlineSource
doc: Where a glyph's outline comes from.

name: flattenQuad
doc: Flatten a quadratic Bézier to `out` by adaptive subdivision.

name: flattenGlyphContours
doc: Flatten TrueType quadratic contours to polylines under `m` (font→target).

name: glyphPolys
doc: Glyph `gid` as polylines under `m`, which maps EM units (y-up) to the target  space — the font's own unitsPerEm is divided out here, so callers never see  font units.

name: faceOutline
doc: A per-character outline reader for one face, for SvgFace.outline.
return_type: (ch: string, m: Matrix, tol: number) => Poly[] | null

doc: Whichever font program a `/FontDescriptor` embeds.

name: isSfnt
doc: True when `raw` begins with an sfnt version tag (OTTO / TrueType / collection).

name: loadEmbeddedProgram
doc: Load `/FontFile2` (TrueType), `/FontFile3` (CFF / OpenType-CFF) or `/FontFile` (Type 1), in that precedence.

name: gidForProgram
doc: Resolve a *simple* font's character code to a glyph id in `prog`.

name: gidForCid
doc: The glyph a COMPOSITE font's CID selects in `prog`.

name: FontUsage
doc: Glyphs a font actually shows, and whether that set is trustworthy.

properties.name: complete
properties.doc: False when some usage site could not be scanned — the font must be skipped.

name: CodeMapper
doc: Resolves character codes to GIDs for one font dict.

properties.name: tokens
properties.doc: The `maxContentTokens` count for the page being walked — reset by `walkPage`, so a form reached from  that page, its annotations, patterns and Type 3 procedures charge it, shared by every stream it  parses rather than counted afresh per stream (`ibzo.8`, `ibzo.9`).

name: unionChains
doc: Union the answers of several chains; undefined when every one comes up empty.

name: resolveDict
doc: Resolve `o` to a dict, or undefined.

name: buildMapper
doc: Build a code->GID mapper, or a reason the font cannot be handled.

name: sfntOf
doc: Parse a simple font's embedded sfnt program (/FontFile2, or an /OpenType  /FontFile3 whole-embed).

name: unicodeCmap
doc: The best Unicode cmap subtable, scored as readCmap does but never falling  back to a (3,0) symbol table — this chain must read Unicode.

name: simpleTrueTypeMapper
doc: Simple TrueType, PDF 32000 9.6.6.4.

name: simpleCffMapper
doc: Simple CFF (`/FontFile3` `/Subtype /Type1C`, or an OTTO whole-embed): the  chain runs code -> glyph *name* -> charset -> GID, the opposite direction from  a CID-keyed font.

name: cffBytesOf
doc: The CFF bytes of a FontFile3 — either a bare CFF or the CFF table of an  OpenType (OTTO) whole-embed.

name: markIncomplete
doc: Mark a font unusable, keeping the first reason recorded.

name: record
doc: Split a show string into codes and record their GIDs.

name: walkOps
doc: Walk one graphics scope: an op stream plus the resources it resolves against.

name: walkStream
doc: Parse and walk a content stream.

name: markScopeIncomplete
doc: Mark every font reachable from `resources` unusable.

name: walkAnnotations
doc: Every /AP appearance stream on a page's annotations: /N, /D, /R, including  the sub-dictionary form (/N << /On 5 0 R /Off 6 0 R >>).

name: walkPatterns
doc: Every tiling pattern (PatternType 1) in a resource dict.

name: walkType3
doc: A Type3 font's glyph procedures can show text in *other* fonts.

name: collectGlyphUsage
doc: Scan every site that can show a glyph and return per-font used GIDs.

doc: One gradient stop.

name: StopPick
doc: How a stop projects onto a shading function's output vector.

doc: An axial (linear) gradient: a colour ramp along the axis from (x1, y1) to  (x2, y2), in the **default** user space of the content stream it paints into  — see the /Matrix note on PageGraphics.setFillGradient.

properties.name: extend
properties.doc: Whether to pad the ramp before the start and after the end.

name: RadialGradient
doc: A radial gradient: the ramp runs from the focal point out to the circle  (cx, cy, r).

doc: Which twin a shading builds: the DeviceRGB colour ramp, or the DeviceGray  luminosity twin that masks it when the stop alphas differ.

doc: Prepare stops for a PDF function: offsets forced non-decreasing, then a stop  added at 0 and at 1 when the list does not already reach them (repeating the  adjacent colour).

name: rampFunction
doc: A type 2 exponential over [0, 1], linear (/N 1) between two colour vectors.

name: stopsFunction
doc: The function for a normalized stop list, over /Domain [0 1].

name: uniformOpacity
doc: Every stop carrying the same alpha, else null.

name: validateGradient
doc: Validate a gradient completely, throwing TypeError on the first fault.

name: variantOf
doc: The colour space and stop projection for a variant, in one place so the twins  cannot drift apart.

name: axialShading
doc: A ShadingType 2 over the gradient's axis.

name: radialShading
doc: A ShadingType 3 running from the focal point out to the circle  (cx, cy, r).

name: shadingPattern
doc: Wrap a shading in a PatternType 2 shading pattern.

name: stopOpacity
doc: A stop's alpha, defaulting to fully opaque.

name: ALPHA
doc: The alpha ramp's projection: one /DeviceGray component, since the luminosity  of a gray value g is g.

doc: Split at the population-weighted median along the longest axis.

name: average
doc: The population-weighted mean colour of a box — the palette entry it becomes.

name: quantize
doc: Quantize interleaved 8-bit RGB to a palette of at most `max` entries.

name: ImageFormat
doc: What `ImageOptions.format` accepts.

name: ImageMode
doc: What `ImageOptions.mode` accepts — a CLOSED union for `ImageFormat`'s  reason, and validated at runtime for its reason too: this ships as  JavaScript, where an unrecognised mode silently returning RGB is a file that  is not what was asked for.

properties.name: format
properties.doc: Output encoding.

properties.name: quality
properties.doc: Encoder quality, 1..100 on the IJG scale.

properties.name: compression

properties.doc: Which page box defines the viewport.

properties.name: annotations

properties.name: mode

properties.name: threshold

methods.name: bounds
methods.return_type: { x0: number; y0: number; x1: number; y1: number }
methods.doc: This canvas's device-space window: [x0,x1) × [y0,y1).

methods.name: blend
methods.doc: Source-over composite `color` at coverage `cov` (0..1) onto pixel (x,y),  through blend function `mode` (PDF 32000-1 §11.3.5).

methods.name: toRgb
methods.doc: Interleaved 8-bit RGB, alpha DISCARDED rather than composited — which is  right only because the caller has already established the canvas is  opaque (`opaqueWhite`, so it was seeded to white and every draw  composited over it).

methods.name: toRgba
methods.doc: Interleaved 8-bit RGBA, straight alpha.

methods.name: toGray
methods.doc: One 8-bit sample per pixel, Rec.

methods.name: toBilevel
methods.doc: One BIT per pixel, MSB-first with rows padded to a byte — a plain cut at `threshold`, never a dither.

properties.name: originX
properties.doc: Device-space origin of this canvas.

properties.name: groupAlpha
properties.doc: Group-only accumulated alpha.

properties.name: shape
properties.doc: Geometric coverage (shape f_j, §11.4.8), before constant alpha (ca).

properties.name: knockoutBackdrop
properties.doc: Frozen initial backdrop B0 of a knockout group (RGBA, straight alpha).

name: Accumulator
doc: Accumulates signed trapezoidal area per cell; a horizontal prefix sum per row  yields fractional coverage.

methods.name: line
methods.doc: Accumulate one edge (device/local coords, y downward).

methods.name: composite
methods.doc: Sweep to coverage and composite onto `canvas` at (ox,oy), applying the  winding rule and scaling by the paint's clip × soft mask × alpha.

methods.name: coverage
methods.doc: Sweep to a coverage buffer for the local bbox (row-major, `w`×`h`).

name: ClipMask
doc: A rasterized clip: fractional coverage 0..1 over `[x0,x1)×[y0,y1)`; fully  transparent (0) outside the bbox.

methods.name: intersect
methods.doc: Intersect with another mask: coverage is the product over the overlap bbox.

name: Paint
doc: Everything that scales a paint operation's coverage, bundled so the five  rasterize* entry points take one parameter instead of four: the clip, the  soft mask (a separate slot — /SMask /None clears it without touching the  clip), constant alpha (ca/CA), and the blend mode.

methods.name: at
methods.doc: Combined coverage multiplier at a device pixel: clip × softMask × alpha.

methods.name: shapeAt
methods.doc: Coverage multiplier WITHOUT constant alpha: clip × softMask.

methods.name: bounds

name: ShadingEval

doc: Options for {@link renderDocumentToTiff}.

doc: Accumulate closed device-space polylines into an accumulator over their bbox  (clamped to `[0,w)×[0,h)`), returning the accumulator and its origin — or  undefined when the geometry is empty/off-canvas.

doc: Bilinearly sample straight-alpha RGBA at (u,v) ∈ [0,1); edges clamp.

doc: Paint `img` over the unit square mapped by `ctm`: inverse-map each device pixel  in the transformed bbox to image UV (row 0 at top → v = 1 − y), sample bilinear,  and composite under the active clip.

name: installedSubstitute
doc: The installed face for a non-embedded font, or undefined to fall back to the  bundled Standard-14 substitute.

name: symbolicUnknown
doc: Whether a non-embedded font is one we cannot identify AT ALL, so that drawing placeholder boxes says less than a Latin substitute would say wrongly (`lqcs.4`).

name: gidForCode
doc: Resolve a character/CID code to a glyph id in the embedded program.

name: drawGlyphPlaceholder
doc: Outline a low-coverage placeholder box for a non-embedded glyph, in em space.

name: eachGlyph
doc: Walk a run's glyphs, handing each its em→device matrix and its outline  polygons (empty when the glyph has none, undefined when no gid resolved).

params.name: fn
params.type: (g: Glyph, emMatrix: Matrix, polys: Poly[] | undefined) => void

name: rasterizeGlyphRun
doc: Draw one glyph run, filled and/or stroked per the text rendering mode.

name: glyphRunPolys
doc: Every outline polygon of a run, in device space — the geometry a pattern fill  clips to.

name: shadingLut
doc: Build a 257-entry color LUT over the parametric domain `[t0,t1]`, so the  per-pixel loop indexes instead of re-evaluating the (possibly costly) function.

name: axialEval
doc: Axial (type 2): project onto the axis and clamp/extend at the ends.

name: radialEval
doc: Radial (type 3): largest parameter `s` whose interpolated circle (with  non-negative radius) passes through the point; clamp/extend beyond the ends.

name: functionEval
doc: Function-based (type 1): the point arrives in the shading's TARGET space, so `inv` — the inverse of `/Matrix` — carries it back to the function's own domain, which is what that matrix maps FROM.

name: rasterizeMesh
doc: Paint a mesh shading — Gouraud (ShadingType 4 or 5) or patch (6 or 7) — returning false when it could not be read, so the caller falls through to the mid-gray degrade and a damaged mesh costs its own appearance, never the page.

params.name: clip
params.type: { x0: number; y0: number; x1: number; y1: number }

name: encodeCanvas
doc: Encode a finished canvas.

name: grayToRgb
doc: A non-rgb mode splayed back across three equal channels, for the two formats  that have no narrower form here.

name: tiffFrameOf
doc: One canvas as the frame shape `tiffencode.ts` consumes.

name: resolveFormat
doc: Resolve `opts.format`, rejecting anything `encodeCanvas` cannot encode and  any option combination the chosen format cannot honour.

name: renderCanvas
doc: Rasterize one page and stop, before any encoder sees it.

name: renderPageToTiffFrame
doc: Render one page to the frame shape `tiffencode.ts` consumes.

name: renderDocumentToTiff
doc: Render a page selection to ONE multi-page TIFF — the entry that makes this  format useful for archival and fax pipelines, which the per-page encoder  alone does not.

name: renderPageToPng
doc: Render one page to a PNG.

name: renderPageBackdropToPng
doc: The backdrop entry `htmlfixed.ts` uses for BOTH raster kinds — the one place  that can hide converted form widgets from a rendered page, which is what  lets `forms: true` work with `backdrop: 'page'` where Go declines.

name: renderPageGraphicsToPng
doc: Render one page's GRAPHICS to a PNG, with every glyph run suppressed.

name: rasterizeFormRgba
doc: Rasterize one Form XObject to straight-alpha sRGB RGBA, top-down, mapping  its /BBox onto exactly devW x devH pixels.

name: IMAGE_FORMATS
doc: Every output encoding `page.ToImage` can produce, and the ONE owner of that  list — `ImageFormat` is derived from it, so the runtime guard and the  compile-time union cannot drift.

name: RasterImage
doc: A decoded raster, ready to become a PDF image XObject.

properties.name: palette
properties.doc: RGB triples, 8 bits each.

properties.name: samples
properties.doc: DeviceGray convention: 0 is BLACK.

properties.name: alpha
properties.doc: One byte per pixel, straight (NOT premultiplied) alpha.

properties.name: samples
properties.doc: 8-bit RGB triples.

properties.name: alpha
properties.doc: One byte per pixel, straight (NOT premultiplied) alpha.

properties.name: samples
properties.doc: 8-bit CMYK quadruples.

name: TrailerChoice
doc: What trailer synthesis chose.

properties.name: rootCandidates
properties.doc: Every /Type /Catalog found, ascending by offset, so a caller can see the  ambiguity: "one catalog, obvious" reads differently from "three, we took  the last".

name: expandObjectStreams
doc: Register every object the /ObjStm containers in `entries` declare, mutating  `entries` in place and returning the object numbers added plus a damage  record for every container that decoded only partially.

name: deref
doc: Resolve one level against a recovered object map; a dangling ref is null.

name: offsetOf
doc: File offset of an object, following a compressed one to its container.

name: chooseCatalog
doc: Identify the document catalog among recovered objects.

name: reachableFrom
doc: Object numbers reachable from `start` by following every ref in the graph.

name: chooseInfo
doc: Identify the /Info dict among recovered objects.

name: findEncryptDict
doc: Find the /Encrypt dict by shape, for a file that lost the reference to it  with its trailer.

name: infoFromXmp
doc: Build an /Info dict from the catalog's XMP packet, for a document that lost  its /Info entirely.

name: rebuildTrailer
doc: Synthesize a trailer for a file that has none left anywhere.

name: recompressOne
doc: Recompress one stream, or undefined to leave it alone.

name: recompressStreams
doc: Flate every unfiltered stream and re-deflate every [FlateDecode] stream at  maximum level, replacing a stream only when the result is strictly smaller.

name: ObjCandidate
doc: One `N G obj` header found in the file.

properties.name: offset
properties.doc: Byte offset of the object number — where an xref entry would point.

properties.name: candidates
properties.doc: Object number -> every candidate found, ascending by file offset.

properties.name: trailerOffsets
properties.doc: Byte offsets just past each `trailer` keyword, latest first.

name: matchHeader
doc: Backtrack from the `obj` keyword at `objAt` over `N G `.

name: sweepObjects
doc: Scan the whole buffer for object headers and `trailer` keywords.

name: RedactOptions
doc: Options for {@link redactPage} / `page.Redact` / `doc.Redact`.

properties.name: region
properties.doc: Restrict the *search* to this page-space rectangle (`redactText` only —  `redactPage` takes explicit rects and never sees this).

properties.name: color
properties.doc: Fill colour of the redaction marker box as [r, g, b] in 0..1 (default black).

properties.name: scrubMetadata
properties.doc: Also clear document metadata (/Info + XMP) when true.

properties.name: keepAnnotations
properties.doc: Keep annotations overlapping a redacted region instead of removing them.

name: GlyphRec
doc: One glyph of an affected show op, with the data needed to keep or drop it.

name: redactRegions
doc: Remove the content under `rects` and hand the validated rects to `paint`.

name: redactPage
doc: Redact every `rects` region on `page`: truly remove covered text and images,  prune resources they leave orphaned, then paint an opaque marker box over  each region.

name: removeRegionContent
doc: Remove covered text glyphs and images from a page in a single per-stream  rebuild, so glyph rewrites and image removals on the same stream can't drift  each other's op indices.

name: intersects
doc: Inclusive AABB overlap: touching edges count as intersecting.

name: contains
doc: True when box `q` lies entirely within rect `r`.

name: removeGlyphsUnder
doc: Remove text whose glyphs fall inside any of `rects` from a page's content,  applying the edits to `ec` (the caller commits).

name: removeImagesUnder
doc: Remove image content (image XObject `Do` and inline `BI…EI`) whose placement  box falls inside any of `rects`, applying edits to `ec` (the caller commits).

name: paintRedactionBoxes
doc: Paint an opaque filled rectangle (default black) over each region as the  visible redaction marker.

name: sampleComponents
doc: Number of sample components per pixel for a colorspace we can lay out from the  image dict alone, or undefined when it can't be determined reliably (a bare  non-device name — e.g.

name: sampleRedactPlan
doc: If `stream` is eligible for sample-level blanking (its filter decodes to  samples in the original colorspace, it has no mask/soft-mask, and its  colorspace + bit-depth are laid-out-able), return `{ nc, bpc }`; else undefined  (caller uses the RGBA fallback).

name: maskClearBit
doc: The non-marking stencil bit for an image mask: 1 under the default /Decode  [0 1] (sample 0 marks), 0 under /Decode [1 0] (sample 1 marks).

name: reflatedInlineDict
doc: Clone an inline image dict for re-encoding as raw FlateDecode: same geometry,  colorspace, bit-depth and /Decode, but drop the original filter, DecodeParms  and length (no predictor), and set /F to /Fl.

name: reencodeRedactedInline
doc: Re-encode a partially-covered inline image (`BI…EI`) in place: blank the  pixels under `rects` (device space) and return a fresh `BI` op.

name: imageStreamOf
doc: Resolve the image XObject stream a `Do` op draws, given (read-only) resources.

name: rewriteShowOp
doc: Rewrite a single show op (Tj/'/"/TJ) into an equivalent op sequence with the  covered glyphs replaced by numeric advance shifts.

name: tjFromString
doc: Build a TJ op from a single show string, dropping covered glyphs.

name: tjFromArray
doc: Rebuild a TJ array: keep original numeric kerns, split string elements.

name: appendStringElement
doc: Append one show string to the TJ output, emitting survivor byte-runs as  strings and covered runs as numeric shifts equal to their advance.

name: redactText
doc: Redact every occurrence of `find` (a literal string or RegExp) on `page`:  search the page's assembled text, then remove and mark every matched region  in a single {@link redactPage} pass (honoring `opts.color` /  `opts.scrubMetadata`).

name: normRect
doc: A rect as [minX, minY, maxX, maxY], however the corners were ordered.

name: subtypeOf
doc: /Subtype name without the leading slash; '' when absent.

name: fieldOf
doc: The terminal field a widget belongs to: the widget itself when it is a merged  field/widget dict (it carries /FT), otherwise the nearest /Parent that does.

name: removeCoveredAnnotations
doc: Remove every annotation on `page` whose /Rect intersects one of `rects`, and return how many went.

name: ApplyRedactionsOptions
doc: Options for `Page.ApplyRedactions` / `Document.ApplyRedactions`.

properties.name: scrubMetadata
properties.doc: Also clear document metadata (/Info + XMP) when true.

properties.name: keepAnnotations
properties.doc: Keep annotations overlapping a redacted region instead of removing them.

name: MarkRedactTextOptions
doc: Options for `Page.MarkRedactText` — everything `AddRedact` takes except the  geometry, which comes from the search hit, plus the search scope.

name: redactRects
doc: The regions a mark covers: one Rect per /QuadPoints quad (its bounding box),  falling back to /Rect when /QuadPoints is absent — a foreign producer may omit  it, though `AddRedact` always writes it.

name: overlayElement
doc: A fresh /P for one region's overlay, or undefined when the document is not  tagged — an untagged document has no tree to attach to, and emitting an  /MCID with no /StructTreeRoot would be worse than leaving the content plain.

name: paintOverlayForm
doc: Place the mark's /RO overlay form into the page at its /Rect.

name: paintRedactOverlay
doc: Paint what a mark leaves behind: the /IC fill over each region, then its  /OverlayText in the /DA font, size and colour, anchored by /Q and tiled when  /Repeat is set.

name: applyRedactions
doc: Apply every /Redact mark on `page`: destroy the marked content, paint each  mark's overlay, then remove the marks.

name: markRedactText
doc: Mark every occurrence of `find` (a literal string or RegExp) on `page` with a  /Redact annotation, using the same search as `Search`.

name: resampleBox
doc: Box-filter downsample of an interleaved 8-bit sample plane.

name: referencedNames
doc: Names still referenced by `ops`, bucketed by resource sub-dict.

name: pruneResources
doc: Delete entries of each prunable sub-dict of `resources` not in `refs`.

name: sanitizeResources
doc: Prune resources orphaned by R1/R2 from the page and every edited Form  XObject, so removed text/images cannot be recovered from leftover resources  (newly-unreachable objects are swept by `Save`).

name: RevocationStatus

name: RevocationMaterial

name: certKeyBytes

name: findIssuer
doc: Find the issuer certificate of `cert` among `pool` (subject == cert.issuer),  or `cert` itself when self-issued / no better match is available.

name: parseOcspResponse
doc: Parse an `OCSPResponse` (RFC 6960).

name: ocspStatus

name: verifyOcspSignature
doc: Verify the BasicOCSPResponse signature against an embedded responder cert or  the `issuer` cert (a directly-issued OCSP response).

name: parseCrl
doc: Parse a `CertificateList` (CRL, RFC 5280).

name: crlStatus

name: verifyCrlSignature

name: parseAsn1Time

properties.name: certReq

properties.name: reqPolicy
properties.doc: Request a specific TSA policy OID.

name: TimestampInfo
doc: Verdict on a signature timestamp: the asserted time plus whether the token  binds to the signature (imprint) and whether the TSA's signature is valid.

properties.name: time
properties.doc: The TSA-asserted signing time (`genTime`).

properties.name: imprintMatches

properties.name: tokenSignatureValid
properties.doc: Whether the TSA's CMS signature over the TSTInfo verifies.

properties.name: valid

properties.name: policy

properties.name: serialNumber

name: parseTimeStampRequest
doc: Parse the message imprint and nonce out of a DER `TimeStampReq`.

name: extractTimeStampToken
doc: Normalize a TSA reply into a bare `TimeStampToken` (ContentInfo): pass a  ContentInfo through unchanged, or unwrap the token from a `TimeStampResp`.

name: extractTstInfoBytes
doc: The TSTInfo bytes embedded as the eContent of a TimeStampToken.

name: buildTimeStampToken
doc: Assemble a `TimeStampToken` for `request`, signed by `signer` (the TSA): echo  the request's imprint/nonce into a TSTInfo, embed it as the eContent of a CMS  SignedData, and sign.

name: parseTstInfo
doc: Parse the TSTInfo carried by a TimeStampToken.

name: verifyTimestampToken
doc: Verify a TimeStampToken against the `signedValue` it timestamps (the outer  signature's signatureValue): check the message-imprint binding and the TSA's  own CMS signature over the embedded TSTInfo.

name: parseGeneralizedTime
doc: Parse an ASN.1 GeneralizedTime (`YYYYMMDDHHMMSS[.fff]Z`) to a Date (UTC).

name: Builder
doc: Accumulates paragraphs while walking.

methods.name: text

name: RichBody

name: faceOf
doc: The Standard-14 face for a style: regular, bold, italic, bold-italic.

name: styleFromFace
doc: A base style from a Standard-14 face — how a FreeText's /DA font seeds the  run model.

name: sizeOf
doc: A font size from one token: pt, px (x0.75), em (x parent), in, mm, cm,  percent, or a unitless number read as pt — which producers do write.

name: familyOf
doc: The first recognised family among comma-separated parts of `v`.

name: applyFont

name: applyStyle

name: RichTextOptions

properties.name: verbatim

properties.name: mcid

properties.name: encrypt

properties.doc: Emit a linearized ("Fast Web View") layout (classic xref, plaintext only).

properties.name: streamFilter

properties.name: incremental
properties.doc: Append an incremental update to the bytes the document was opened from,  rather than rewriting it.

properties.name: objs

properties.doc: Object number (in the live `objects` map) of the signature value dictionary  whose `/Contents`/`/ByteRange` must be emitted as a patchable placeholder.

name: trailerExtras

name: serializeDocument
doc: Serialize the live object map to bytes.

name: headerVersion
doc: The header version to emit: catalog /Version when present, else 1.7.

name: serializeSignedDocument
doc: Sign-on-save (full-rewrite) serialization: emit a classic-xref document in  which the signature value dictionary carries a fixed-size `/Contents`  placeholder and a computed `/ByteRange`, ready to digest and fill.

name: serializeClassicSigned

name: segmentBoxes

name: flowTextBlock

methods.name: AddAnnotation
methods.doc: Tag an annotation (e.g.

methods.name: SetTableAttributes

methods.name: SetListAttributes
methods.doc: Merge list attributes into this element's /A.

methods.name: SetLayoutAttributes
methods.doc: Merge layout attributes into this element's /A.

properties.name: Depth

name: StructTreeRoot

methods.name: ResolveRole

methods.name: GetText

methods.name: Append
methods.doc: Create a top-level structure element of `type` and return its handle.
